["R01R_A_DAYSQUIT_CIGS: DERIVED - Number of days since last smoked cigarettes

  Long Description: Recode of length of time since last smoked cigarette into days for
  respondents who have ever used AND (currently use not at all OR have used in the past
  30 days). Note: For all products, except cigarettes and hookah, former 30 day users
  includes some respondents who have indicated that while they have used in the past 30
  days, they have also used on zero of past 30 days. Respondents who are former 30 day
  users of cigarettes or hookah will not have reported using zero of the past 30 days.

  Algorithm:

  IF R01_AC1009_NN > 0 THEN { IF R01_AC1009_UN=1 THEN R01R_A_DAYSQUIT_CIGS
  = R01_AC1009_NN ELSE
  IF R01_AC1009_UN = 2 THEN R01R_A_DAYSQUIT_CIGS = R01_AC1009_NN*30.4375
  ELSE IF R01_AC1009_UN = 3 THEN
  R01R_A_DAYSQUIT_CIGS = R01_AC1009_NN*365.25 } ELSE IF R01_AC1009_NN = -9
  THEN R01R_A_DAYSQUIT_CIGS = -99999; ELSE IF
  R01_AC1009_NN = -8 THEN R01R_A_DAYSQUIT_CIGS = -99988; ELSE IF
  R01_AC1009_NN = -7 THEN R01R_A_DAYSQUIT_CIGS = -99977;
  ELSE IF R01_AC1009_NN = -5 THEN R01R_A_DAYSQUIT_CIGS = -99955;
  ELSE IF R01_AC1009_NN = -1 THEN R01R_A_DAYSQUIT_CIGS =
  -99911;"]

Cigarette (Non-Current Smokers)

  Long Description: Wave 5 adult recode of length of time since last smoked a cigarette into days for
  smokers who do not currently smoke at all or did not smoke in the past 12 months.

  R05R_A_DAYSQUIT_CIGS = -99988; ELSE IF R05_AC1009_NN = -7 THEN
  R05R_A_DAYSQUIT_CIGS = -99977; ELSE IF R05_AC1009_NN = -5 THEN
  R05R_A_DAYSQUIT_CIGS = -99955; ELSE IF R05_AC1009_NN = -1 THEN
  R05R_A_DAYSQUIT_CIGS = -99911;"]

  former established cigarette smokers who had not reported ever smoking cigarettes fairly regularly as
  of their last completed interview and have ever smoked cigarettes fairly regularly, into single
  cigarettes.
